heading: ## Mutation-sweep recipe — numbered steps; bounded cold-read evidence

findings.title: Replay clone provenance is not retained
findings.evidence: All 46 command records match commands.json, but none records the tameshi clone creation/checkout, clone rev-parse HEAD at C0b, or a hash of the clone SKILL.md used by driver commands 17-20. Command 39 hashes git-show C0b instead of that driver input.
findings.impact: C0b section identity is independently confirmed; the retained replay inputs (including Appendix manifests and pointer-source clone) are not independently bound to C0b by these receipts. This is missing evidence, not proof of a wrong revision.
findings.recommendation: Limit the claim to retained observations until clone revision/input-byte evidence is available; do not rerun under this recovery assignment.

findings.title: Survivor probe fixture inputs are not retained
findings.evidence: Commands 22-28 retain argv, exit and outputs, but retained directory contains only bash-sweep.json, commands.json, js-sweep.json, mutate_driver.py, section.txt, self-evaluation.json. No probe/probe2 census.tsv, shapes.tsv, baseline.tsv, host-file bytes/modes or fixture-construction source is retained; mutate_driver.py only constructs suite mutants.
findings.impact: Observed non-equivalence outputs agree with the report, but the exact off-suite input setups cannot be reconstructed from this receipt set alone after scratch deletion.
findings.recommendation: Describe survivor probes as output-backed observations with unavailable exact fixture inputs, rather than a fully retained reproduction recipe.
